subject: Lockbox & invoice batching - sustaincloud PO/terms questions
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Amrita Rao <amrita.rao@sustaincloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lockbox & invoice batching - sustaincloud PO/terms questions

Hi Amrita,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To make sure procurement has everything for your PO team, a couple of clarifying questions on how you want us to invoice and how you handle lockbox remittance:

- Do you require a bank lockbox (lockbox@bank.com) for payments, or will invoices go to billing@SustainCloud.com for ACH/Wire?
- Preferred invoice cadence: consolidated monthly by BU (preferred), or would you need weekly/biweekly batches during ramp?
- PO metadata: you mentioned a custom PO number format (BU-YYYY-###). Can you confirm the PO field that needs to appear on every invoice (PO: , Project Code: , Cost Center: )?
- Net terms: can you confirm if Net-90 is mandatory from procurement, or whether Net-45 is acceptable for initial onboarding?

I've attached a current SOW and a sample PO template that maps our invoice fields to common ERPs — happy to update if you need a different mapping. If Net-90 is a hard requirement, we will need to route to Finance for an exception (and discuss offsetting controls).

Next steps: once you confirm the answers above I can loop in Ben from Finance to agree on any exception mechanics.

Best,
Priyom
Director, Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sow_v2.pdf (PDF), po_template.xlsx (Excel)
From: Amrita Rao <amrita.rao@sustaincloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: SustainCloud Procurement <procurement@sustaincloud.com>, Evan Lee <evan.lee@sustaincloud.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lockbox & invoice batching - sustaincloud PO/terms questions

Hi Priyom — thanks for the note and the SOW. Answering inline: 

- Lockbox: yes, our AP team requires payment via a lockbox for vendors over $250k ARR. Remit to lockbox@bank.com (they will provide remittance details on the PO).
- Invoice cadence: we prefer a consolidated monthly invoice by BU. However, during the first 60–90 days we sometimes request biweekly batches to help cashflow reporting.
- PO metadata: please include these three fields on the invoice: PO Number, BU Code, and SustainCloud Project ID (SCPID). Our ERP will auto-match on PO Number + BU Code.
- Net terms: procurement is asking for Net-90 for strategic platform partnerships. That is our org default for this category. If you cannot accept Net-90, we can explore other mitigations (advance deposit, prepay credit, or early-pay discounts).

We also need a completed vendor onboarding form (attached) and a copy of your W-9 / tax ID.

If you can share the Finance exception path and any discount options you can offer for alternative payment terms, please do and we'll coordinate with legal and AP.

Best,
Amrita Rao
Head of Procurement
SustainCloud

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Amrita Rao <amrita.rao@sustaincloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lockbox & invoice batching - sustaincloud PO/terms questions

Amrita — appreciate the detail. Quick follow-up and two proposed options so procurement has something concrete to take to AP/Legal: 

Option A (recommended for faster onboarding):
- Terms: Net-45
- Invoice cadence: consolidated monthly by BU
- Offset: 1.5% early-pay discount if paid within 10 days
- Lockbox: we can remit to the lockbox address you provide; invoices should include PO Number + BU Code + SCPID for auto-match

Option B (if Net-90 is mandatory):
- Terms: Net-90 accepted only with either (i) 10% prepay credit applied to first 6 months or (ii) an executed 12-month minimum spend commitment (we can draft an addendum)
- Invoice cadence: consolidated monthly; we will provide remittance instructions that include the lockbox account and reference fields

If you prefer a hybrid for ramp: we can do biweekly invoices for the first 60 days then switch to monthly consolidated invoices.

Ben — looping you in for Finance exception mechanics if procurement pushes for Net-90. Amrita, can you confirm which option your team prefers so we can prepare a PO-ready statement of work and the formal exception paperwork if needed?

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Amrita Rao <amrita.rao@sustaincloud.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Lockbox & invoice batching - sustaincloud PO/terms questions

Priyom / Laura — I reviewed SustainCloud's request. Finance is willing to approve a narrow exception with the following guardrails: 

- One-time exception to accept Net-60 (not Net-90) for initial contract if SustainCloud provides a $50,000 deposit to be applied against the first invoices.
- They must sign a 12-month minimum commitment (Deal DL-47831) and include PO Number + BU Code + SCPID exactly as specified.
- We require a completed Finance Exception form and approval chain itemized (attached).
- Lockbox is acceptable; ensure remittance reference includes our invoice ID and PO Number so we can reconcile.

If SustainCloud insists on Net-90 we need additional credit protection (letter of credit or prepay > 25% of ARR) — those are high-friction asks. Recommend we offer Net-60 + $50k deposit and a modest 3% onboarding credit to be applied if they prepay first invoice within 10 days.

Ben Carter
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Finance-Exception-Form.pdf (PDF)

Thanks, everyone. SustainCloud can accept the Net-60 + $50k deposit path you outlined (Ben's suggestion) — that aligns with AP's risk tolerance and keeps the onboarding timeline short. Two quick asks from our side before we issue PO: 

1) Please confirm the exact invoice fields you will include (we need PO Number, BU Code, SCPID, Redwood Invoice ID, and Tax ID on each invoice).
2) Provide the lockbox remittance configuration you will reference on the invoice (bank name, account mask, and email lockbox@bank.com) so our ERP can auto-match.

We'll circulate an initial PO this afternoon with DL-47831 referenced in the header and send the signed onboarding form. Evan — I'll loop you in with the PO when it lands.

Best,
Amrita
